HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about African Civilisations is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations.
   C. Say African Civilisations never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat African Civilisations as rumours only.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

5. Which statement about Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya.
   B. Treat Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human developmen ts in Africa.
   B. Treat Human developmen ts in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Human developmen ts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa.
   B. Say Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha.
   D. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period as rumours only.
   B. Say Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period.
   D. Explain Social, Economic and Political changes during the colonial period with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Colonialism in Contemporary Society is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonialism in Contemporary Society as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonialism in Contemporary Society.
   C. Explain Colonialism in Contemporary Society with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Colonialism in Contemporary Society never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence as rumours only.
   B. Say Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence.
   D. Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain International conventions on Human rights for special groups and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain African Diaspora and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain rd Generation Industrial Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The 4 th Generation of Industrial Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
